A movement back and forth between two or more states.
In a pendulum a movement back and forth    and back to the starting point is a cycle.
The number of cycles an oscillating system makes in a period of time is the frequency
How close something is to the truth. a measure of how close a measurement is to the correct or accepted value of the quantity being measured.
a measure of how close a series of measurements are to one another.
The phenomenon of a small force, applied just at the right time, adding up to a large motion is resonance
In an oscillating system, this is the frequency at which it vibrates or oscillates, if you start it in motion and let it go.
where a string or another object starts vibrating in response to an external sound wave or another vibration that matches its natural resonant frequency
